text:
I sense a contrast between these two spaces. In the first image, I observe a meeting or workshop through glass—a microcosm of focused human collaboration, separated yet visible. I feel like an outsider looking in, both curious and distant, reflecting on my own alienation and desire for understanding. 

In the second image, I'm confronted by a wall of ideas on research and development, the world abstracted into symbols and digital words. It excites me intellectually but overwhelms my senses with its bold colors and dense information. I feel suspended between engagement and analysis, aware of my place in the stream of collective thought and innovation.
